summary: Runner SSH known_hosts cache causing intermittent git fetch failures after bastion host key rotation
description:
Issue summary: After the scheduled bastion host SSH key rotation on 2026-03-09, a subset of CI runners began failing git fetch/clone operations with host key mismatch errors. Impact: ~12% of builds that need to access private repos via the bastion experienced checkout failures, causing release and nightly pipelines to flake. This appears limited to ephemeral runners that had previously cached known_hosts entries, and the failures started immediately after rotation.

Observed error sample: 'WARNING: REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED!
IT IS POSSIBLE THAT SOMEONE IS DOING SOMETHING NASTY!' followed by 'Host key verification failed.'

Business impact: Delays to canary release jobs and CI congestion as retries accumulate. No customer-facing outages, but blocking release cadence for two engineering teams.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Provision ephemeral runner that will route git traffic through bastion egress proxy.
2) Ensure known_hosts for bastion present in runner image (from prior successful checkouts).
3) Rotate bastion host SSH key (performed by infra schedule on 2026-03-09).
4) Trigger pipeline that performs 'git clone' of internal repo. Observe host key mismatch and checkout failure.
logs: run-2026-03-10-12:14:23 - git@bastion.internal: Permission denied (publickey). Host key verification failed.
runner-ephemeral-xy12 - ssh: handshake failed: host key mismatch: got 'ecdsa-sha2-nistp256' expected 'rsa-sha2-512'
investigation_notes: 03/10 09:00 - Triage: Correlation between bastion key rotation window and spike in runner checkout failures. Not all runners affected; pattern tied to runners that retain known_hosts across warm pool cycles.

03/10 10:22 - Hypothesis: Ephemeral runners reuse filesystem layers or cached /home/runner/.ssh/known_hosts entry created before rotation; SSH client refuses new key causing immediate failure instead of interactive fingerprint acceptance.
03/10 11:05 - Verified: New long-lived dedicated runners (fresh instances) do not fail; ephemeral warm pool runners with preserved workspace show failures.
03/11 14:30 - Found CI image build step that pre-populates known_hosts using 'ssh-keyscan' at image bake time. Image bake predates rotation and therefore contains stale key for affected runners.
03/11 16:00 - Cross-reference: linked infra runbook for bastion rotation (CON-BASTION-ROTATE) lacks a step to invalidate runner caches or trigger pool recycle. Added as follow-up.
mitigation: Short-term: Add a pre-check job to affected pipelines to run 'ssh-keyscan -H bastion.internal >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts' before git operations; rolling patch applied to two failing repos as a stopgap. Medium-term: Update runner warm-pool lifecycle to clear ~/.ssh/known_hosts on start and ensure image bake process does not bake static bastion keys.
resolution: Work in progress. Emergency mitigation (pre-check ssh-keyscan) deployed to release pipelines on 2026-03-11 which reduced failure rate to <1%. Follow-up tasks created to bake image fix and to update bastion rotation runbook. Will close ticket once warm-pool fix is deployed and monitored for 48h without regression.
comments: Ava Mitchell (03/10): Raised after release engineer reported flakiness for canary deploy jobs. Attaching job IDs and sample logs.
Diego Ramos (03/10): Investigating; suspect known_hosts cache. Requested list of runner IDs and image bake timestamps.
SRE - Priya Shah (03/11): Confirmed bastion rotation executed 2026-03-09 03:02 UTC. No other network changes. Suggest running 'ssh-keyscan' as temporary workaround.
BuildME - Jordan Lee (03/11): Applied ssh-keyscan pre-step in repo 'infra/deploy-svc' and observed successful run after one retry. Recommending org-wide mitigation rollout.
Diego Ramos (03/12): Created PR to runner-AMI pipeline to remove baked known_hosts and added init script to prune ~/.ssh/known_hosts at startup. PR: github.com/redwood/runner-images/pull/1743
follow_up_actions: 1) Merge runner-images PR to remove baked known_hosts and push new AMI (owner: Diego Ramos).
2) Update bastion rotation runbook to include a runner warm-pool recycle step (owner: Priya Shah).
3) Add automated CI smoke test that runs ssh-keyscan against bastion in prelude for pipelines that use bastion egress (owner: Jordan Lee).
4) Monitor failure rate for 48 hours post-deploy and close ticket if stable (owner: Support Team).
